options.name: api_url
options.description: PX-Backup API URL

options.name: backup_object_type
options.description: Type of backup objects to restore

options.name: backup_ref
options.description: Reference to backup

options.name: cluster
options.description: Name or UID of the cluster

options.name: cluster_ref
options.description: Reference to cluster

options.name: exclude_resources
options.description: List of specific resources to exclude from restore

options.name: file_level_restore_info
options.description: File level restore configuration for VM backups

options.name: filter
options.description: Advanced filtering options for restore operations

options.name: include_optional_resource_types
options.description: List of optional resource types to include in the restore By default, some resource types may be excluded Use this to explicitly include specific resource types Example: ["v1/Secret", "v1/ConfigMap"]

options.name: include_resources
options.description: List of specific resources to include in restore

options.name: is_sfr
options.description: Set to true for VirtualMachine file level restore Enables restoration of specific files/directories from VM backups Requires file_level_restore_info when set to true

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the restore Required for all operations except INSPECT_ALL

options.name: namespace_mapping
options.description: Mapping of source and destination namespaces during restore Should be used only when restore is done WITHOUT using filter Mutually exclusive with target_namespace_prefix Set namespace_mapping equal if is_sfr is set to true Example: {"source-ns": "target-ns", "app-prod": "app-prod-restored"}

options.name: operation
options.description: Operation to perform on the restore - CREATE: creates a new restore - DELETE: removes a restore - INSPECT_ONE: retrieves details of a specific restore - INSPECT_ALL: lists all restores

options.name: org_id
options.description: Organization ID

options.name: rancher_project_mapping
options.description: Mapping of rancher projects from the backup to which restore should be done Format is source_project_id:target_project_id Can specify multiple project mappings Example: {"c-abc123:p-xyz789": "c-def456:p-uvw012", "c-abc123:p-xyz790": "c-def456:p-uvw013"}

options.name: rancher_project_name_mapping
options.description: Mapping of source rancher project display names to target rancher project display names Format is source_project_name:target_project_name Can specify multiple project name mappings Example: {"Production Project": "DR Production Project", "Staging Project": "DR Staging Project"}

options.name: replace_policy
options.description: Policy for handling existing resources during restore Invalid: No policy specified (default) Retain: Keep existing resources, skip restore if resource exists Delete: Delete existing resources before restore

options.name: sort_option
options.description: Sorting configuration for restore enumeration

options.name: ssl_config
options.description: SSL configuration dictionary containing certificate settings Contains validate_certs, ca_cert, client_cert, and client_key options If not provided, defaults to standard SSL verification

options.name: storage_class_mapping
options.description: Mapping of source and destination storage classes during restore Example: {"fast-ssd": "standard-ssd", "slow-hdd": "standard-hdd"}

options.name: target_namespace_prefix
options.description: Prefix to be added to all target namespaces during granular restore with filters Only used when restore is performed WITH filter.namespace_filter Will be ignored when restore is done without using filter For example, if prefix is "dr-" and source namespace is "app-prod", target will be "dr-app-prod" Mutually exclusive with namespace_mapping

options.name: token
options.description: Authentication token

options.name: uid
options.description: Unique identifier of the restore

options.name: virtual_machine_restore_options
options.description: Virtual machine specific restore options
